biggest_catch: This is a high-net-worth offer only: the minimum tier requires parking $150,000 of new money for 90 days, and you must meet with a Private Client banker in a branch — this is not an online-only signup.
catches: $1,000 requires $150,000–$249,999; $2,000 requires $250,000–$499,999; $3,000 requires $500,000+ of qualifying new money or securities transferred within 45 days of offer enrollment, maintained for 90 days.
New money cannot be existing deposits, funds or securities already held at Chase or its affiliates.
To participate you must request an offer code by email, then schedule a meeting with a banker to open or upgrade to a Chase Private Client Checking account — an in-branch step is mandatory.

Chase Private Client Checking carries a $35 monthly service fee, $0 with a $150,000+ average beginning day balance across the checking account plus qualifying linked personal deposit/investment accounts (the bonus-qualifying balance satisfies this while maintained).

Only personal checking, personal savings, and qualifying J.P. Morgan Wealth Management non-retirement accounts (opened in-branch, serviced by a J.P. Morgan Private Client Advisor) count as eligible accounts; CDs, business accounts, self-directed investing, retirement accounts, annuities, fund accounts, 529s, trust/attorney/government accounts are ineligible.
Offer expires October 14, 2026. Account subject to approval; terms subject to change.

The bonus is paid within 40 days after the 90-day maintenance period (i.e., up to ~130 days after enrollment); no early-termination clawback is stated on the offer page, and tax treatment was not stated — bonuses may be taxable and could be reported under applicable tax law.
At a minimum tier, $1,000 on $150,000 held ~90 days equals roughly 2.7% annualized before fees — decent but only if the money would sit idle anyway.

steps: Request your offer code by email on the official Chase Private Client bonus page and schedule a meeting with a banker.
Meet with the banker to open or upgrade to a Chase Private Client Checking account.
Within 45 days of offer enrollment, transfer $150,000+ (for $1,000), $250,000+ (for $2,000), or $500,000+ (for $3,000) of qualifying new money or securities into eligible accounts.
Maintain that new money for 90 days from offer enrollment; the bonus is deposited within 40 days.
timing: Expires 2026-10-14; fund within 45 days of enrollment; maintain 90 days; bonus within 40 days after maintenance period.
